post_title: Autonomous GitHub PR Code Reviewer Pipeline
post_content: This production-grade AI workflow triggers automatically whenever a new Pull Request is opened on GitHub. It pulls the diff, performs static analysis with ruff/eslint, and invokes Claude 3.5 Sonnet to construct structured inline pull request review comments focused on security vulnerabilities, edge cases, and performance bottlenecks.
short_description: Automated n8n + Claude 3.5 Sonnet workflow for inline GitHub PR security and performance code reviews.
tech_stack_text: n8n, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GitHub Webhooks, Python, Docker

post_content: A high-performance batch ingestion workflow that monitors Notion databases, PDF document stores, and technical documentation URLs. It chunks documents intelligently, generates embeddings using OpenAI text-embedding-3-large, and upserts dense vectors into a Qdrant cluster for instant agent retrieval.
short_description: Scalable RAG ingestion pipeline syncing Notion, PDFs, and web docs into Qdrant vector database.

post_content: Official Model Context Protocol server enabling LLMs like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and custom agents to safely query, inspect schemas, and analyze data in SQLite and PostgreSQL databases. Features built-in read-only safety guards and parameterized query execution.
short_description: Model Context Protocol server connecting LLMs to SQLite and Postgres databases with schema inspection.
tech_stack_text: TypeScript, Node.js, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MCP SDK

post_content: Empower your AI coding assistant with direct repository control. This MCP server exposes tools for listing issues, creating pull requests, reading file trees, searching code, and managing CI/CD pipeline triggers.
short_description: MCP Server providing Claude & Cursor with direct tools to read repositories, create PRs, and search code.
tech_stack_text: TypeScript, GitHub REST API, MCP Protocol, Docker

post_content: An autonomous research agent that monitors 50+ tech news feeds, RSS channels, and ArXiv papers every morning. Uses DeepSeek R1 to summarize breakthrough research into executive bullets and delivers formatted digests to Slack and Telegram channels.
short_description: Daily automated news & ArXiv paper summarizer delivering executive briefings to Slack.
tech_stack_text: CrewAI, DeepSeek R1, Python, Slack API
